title: On one open lattice face an integer multiplicity current is an integer L^1 density (Simon (33); parent steps 8, 10-12 per face)
statement: Assume (IMC-b) [the second conjunct of the frozen hypothesis (IMC) of the parent]: for all P, n, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R in U and every set E, if U is open and E is Borel then there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' in U with R' representing A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult and R'.orient = R.orient, and (PO) [the exact frozen type of the sibling Submission.cmcdtfr_plane_orientation]: for all P, n, strictly increasing ι : Fin n → Fin P, A ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, linear subspaces Q ⊆ ℝ^P and n-vectors ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, if a_i = x_i for every a ∈ A and every i ∉ range ι, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q, then either ξ(α) = α(E_ι) for every n-covector α or ξ(α) = −α(E_ι) for every α, where E_ι := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}). Let P, n ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n), and p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing and b ∈ ℤ^P, such that Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) 1) is an isometry ℝ^n → ℝ^P. Let Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝ^n : 0 < y_i < 1 ∀ i}, F̆ := Φ_p(Q₁) and E_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}). Then there is u : ℝ^n → ℝ such that u(y) ∈ ℤ for every y, u is integrable on Q₁ (Lebesgue measure), ENNReal.ofReal(∫_{Q₁} |u|) ≤ R.measure(F̆) (= ∫_{M∩F̆} θ dHⁿ), and for every test n-form ω on ℝ^P (TestFormOn univ n): ∫_{M ∩ F̆} θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫_{Q₁} u(y) ω(Φ_p(y))(E_p) dy.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (p : (Fin n → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)), StrictMono p.1 → Isometry (fun y : Euclid n => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) → ∃ u : Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, u y = z) ∧ IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid n | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in {y : Euclid n | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u y|) ≤ R.measure ((fun y : Euclid n => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) '' {y : Euclid n | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ (fun y : Euclid n => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) '' {y : Euclid n | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n] = ∫ y in {y : Euclid n | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))
